description: Master directory of registered ShopFast shoppers including their contact details, postal address, marketing consent, and loyalty status.
owner: VP Marketing / Head of CRM (Customer Domain Owner)
issues_found: 1) Completeness: 48 missing emails, 30 missing phone numbers, and 37 missing countries. 2) Uniqueness: 8 duplicate customer_id keys (16 rows) and 60 duplicate people registered twice under the same normalized email (120 rows). 3) Validity: 28 malformed email addresses (e.g. double '@@' or missing domain), 13 invalid loyalty_tier spellings ('Platinium', 'GOLD', 'Gold', 'silver '), and 22 invalid French postal codes (not 5 digits). 4) Consistency: 17 different spellings for 4 countries ('FR', 'France', 'fr', 'france ', 'FRA', 'Allemagne', 'Germany', 'DE', 'DEU', etc.), 303 signup_date values and 174 birth_date values not in YYYY-MM-DD ISO format, plus inconsistent phone formats and untrimmed/uppercase names.

description: Catalog of all items sold by ShopFast with their SKU code, category, supplier name, EUR unit price, and active sales status.
issues_found: 1) Completeness: 1 product (product_id 506, Mechanical Keyboard) has a missing (NULL) unit_price_eur. 2) Validity / Accuracy: 1 product (product_id 533, Hand Cream) has a negative unit_price_eur (-22.19 EUR). 3) Uniqueness: duplicate SKU ('SF-FAS-0522' used by two different product_ids, including an Electronics item with a Fashion SKU prefix). 4) Consistency: 11 distinct category strings for 6 actual categories due to trailing spaces and mixed casing ('Fashion ', 'Beauty ', 'Electronics ', 'electronics', 'SPORTS').

description: Header records for every customer purchase order, tracking who bought, when, through which sales channel, shipping destination, delivery status, and order total in EUR.
owner: VP E-Commerce / Head of Sales Operations
sensitivity_level: Confidential (Indirect PII via customer_id & transaction history)
issues_found: 1) Uniqueness: 7 duplicate order_id keys (14 rows). 2) Completeness: 11 orders have a missing (NULL) order_date. 3) Referential Integrity: 14 orders reference a customer_id that does not exist in customers.csv (orphan orders). 4) Validity & Accuracy: 6 orders have zero or negative total_amount_eur (down to -49.90 EUR), and 5 orders have future order_date values in 2027. 5) Consistency: status has non-standard variants ('SHIPPED', 'Delivered', 'delivered ', and US-spelled 'canceled' vs 'cancelled'), and 876 orders have a total_amount_eur that does not match the sum of their order_items.

description: Individual line items belonging to each customer order, listing the specific product purchased, quantity ordered, and unit price charged.
owner: VP E-Commerce / Head of Sales Operations
issues_found: 1) Validity / Accuracy: 8 rows have zero or negative quantities (0 or -1 items ordered). 2) Referential Integrity: 4 rows reference a product_id that does not exist in products.csv (orphan product references). 3) Cross-table Consistency: 335 line items have a unit_price_eur that differs from the catalog unit_price_eur in products.csv, and line totals do not sum up to orders.total_amount_eur for 876 orders.

description: Financial payment transactions and refunds linked to customer orders, recording payment method, EUR amount, payment status, and the last 4 digits of payment cards.
owner: Chief Financial Officer (CFO) / Head of Finance
sensitivity_level: Restricted / Highly Confidential (Financial & PCI card_last4 data)
issues_found: 1) Consistency / Validity: 1,469 non-card payments (517 bank_transfer, 494 paypal, 458 apple_pay) falsely have card_last4 digits populated, while 1,059 'card' payments are missing card_last4. 2) Cross-table Accuracy: 6 payments have an amount that disagrees with orders.total_amount_eur (where order totals are negative/zero). 3) Temporal & Status Consistency: 4 payments have a payment_date earlier than the order's order_date, and 1 cancelled order still has a 'captured' (unrefunded) payment.

description: Customer-service inquiries submitted via chat, phone, or email, containing the customer's free-text message and internal support agent notes.
owner: Head of Customer Support / Customer Care Director
sensitivity_level: Restricted / Highly Confidential (Unstructured sensitive PII: IBANs
column13: 1) Uncontrolled PII / GDPR Risk in Free Text: 215 customer messages leak raw personal and financial data in plain text (full French bank IBANs for refunds, personal phone numbers, work email addresses, and new home addresses). 2) Uncontrolled PII in Agent Notes: 62 agent_notes contain raw customer birth dates ('Customer born YYYY-MM-DD, verified identity'). 3) Completeness: 150 tickets (35.5%) have empty/NULL agent_notes and there is no ticket resolution status column.

description: Ad-hoc extract of customer contact names, email addresses, and loyalty tiers prepared for the Spring 2026 email marketing campaign.
issues_found: 1) Governance / Shadow Data & GDPR Erasure Drift: 19 customers whose email is NULL (missing/erased) in customers.csv still have their email address retained and exposed in this unmanaged extract, and 10 other rows have different emails from customers.csv (29 email mismatches total). 2) Data Drift / Consistency: 8 rows have a different loyalty_tier than customers.csv, and 15 rows differ in first_name formatting. 3) Timeliness & Auditability: Incomplete/stale snapshot covering only customer_id 10001-10904 (600 of 842 consenting customers) with no marketing_consent proof column or export timestamp.
